title: CSS Grid Notes
content: Kept the grid at one width and let the layout breathe. Dropping columns feels better than squeezing text.

title: Canvas Geometry Study
content: The grid looks best when motion is slow and contrast is low. I keep it behind the content.

title: Loader Timing
content: The loader holds long enough to feel deliberate. If the page is fast, it still stays for a beat.

title: Move Log
content: Notation reads better with consistent spacing. I keep the list quiet and aligned.

title: Archive Manifest
content: Version and file size are enough in the archive. The rest can live in notes.

title: Spacing Pass
content: I pushed the margins wider so sections feel separate. The page reads calmer.

title: Theme Toggle
content: A light board option helps on long sessions. Dark stays the default.

title: Notes Index
content: Titles only on the homepage keep it quick. Full entries stay in the Notes page.

title: Gallery Pass
content: SVG studies are small and load instantly offline. I add more when a pattern feels useful.

title: Lab Demos
content: The lab is for showing systems, not selling them. Previews open only when asked.

title: Navigation Dock
content: The docked nav appears only when it matters. The top bar stays quiet at rest.

title: Footer Cut
content: The AXMCR mark stays half-hidden above the footer. It reads like a signature.
